desc: The Orlivane reflective safety vest helps you stand out at night and on busy sites. It has a zipper front, three front pockets plus an ID card pocket, and reflective strips on bright polyester fabric. One size: length 68 cm, chest 58 cm laid flat (about 116 cm around). Available in fluorescent green and fluorescent orange-red.
b: 4 POCKETS — Three front pockets plus an ID card pocket hold a phone, keys, pens and a badge.
ZIPPER FRONT — Zips closed for a neat fit over a T-shirt, hoodie or jacket.
REFLECTIVE STRIPS — Bright fluorescent fabric with reflective strips that catch headlights at night.
ONE SIZE — Length 68 cm (26.8 in), chest 58 cm (22.8 in) laid flat, about 116 cm (45.7 in) around. Please check your measurements before ordering.
FOR WORK AND OUTDOORS — For night running, cycling, dog walking, warehouse and construction work, roadside stops and volunteer events. Fluorescent green or fluorescent orange-red.
